name: USA

meta.title: Study in the USA from India: intakes, OPT, application timeline
meta.description: When US courses start, how early to apply, F-1 work rules, OPT and the STEM OPT extension, and Fulbright-Nehru scholarships for students from India.

summary: Fall and spring starts, 12 months of OPT after a degree, and 24 more months for STEM graduates.

whyReasons.text: After your degree you can work in the US for up to 12 months on OPT. Graduates with an eligible STEM degree can apply for a further 24 months.
Most courses start in August or September, and some universities also admit students for the spring semester in January.
F-1 students can work on campus up to 20 hours a week while classes are running.

applyBy.text: Undergraduate applications are usually due between November and January for a September start. Start your search 12 to 18 months before you want to enrol.

intakes.note: Spring admission is offered by some universities only.

duringStudy.text: On-campus work up to 20 hours a week while school is in session.

afterStudy.text: Optional Practical Training (OPT): up to 12 months per degree level. Graduates with an eligible STEM degree can apply for a 24-month STEM OPT extension with an E-Verify employer.

scholarships.name: Fulbright-Nehru Master's Fellowships
scholarships.text: Fellowships for Indian students to do a master's in the US, run by the United States-India Educational Foundation.

scholarships.name: EducationUSA scholarship listings
scholarships.text: The US State Department's advising network lists university scholarships open to international students.

faq.q: When should I start applying for a US fall intake?
faq.a: Start researching 12 to 18 months before you want to begin. Undergraduate applications are usually due between November and January for a September start.

faq.q: Can I work in the US after my master's?
faq.a: Yes, on OPT for up to 12 months. If your degree is on the STEM list and your employer uses E-Verify, you can apply for 24 more months.

faq.q: Can I work while I study in the US?
faq.a: F-1 students can work on campus up to 20 hours a week while classes are running. Off-campus work needs separate permission.

faq.q: How much does it cost to study in the US?
faq.a: Costs depend on the university and city. There is no single government figure. Your counsellor will give you each shortlisted university's published cost of attendance.
